articles.ai_summary:

articles.summary: A Barclays Bank survey says over half (56%) of UK adults believe energy efficient upgrades are becoming essential because of high utility costs.  And almost two thirds of renters, 63%, say energy efficiency upgrades are becoming essential.  However, many renters say they don’t the ability to make significant upgrades themselves – renters are more likely […]

- Many renters feel they lack the means to implement significant energy-efficient improvements in their homes.

articles.title: Tenants facing consequences of Renters Rights Act – claim
articles.summary: A majority (78%) of landlords in England have no confidence in the lettings sector following the introduction of the Renters Rights Act. A new survey from flatshare website SpareRoom reveals that fewer than 4% of landlords are expanding their portfolios. Meanwhile 36% are reducing their portfolios and 27% are leaving the rental market altogether. More […]
articles.ai_summary:
- **Landlord Distress:** 78% of landlords in England lack confidence in the lettings sector post-Renters Rights Act, with many opting to reduce or exit their portfolios.  
- **Investment Decline:** Less than 4% of landlords are looking to expand their holdings, highlighting a significant downturn in the rental market.

articles.title: Right To Rent changes come in today
articles.summary: From today the Right To Rent (RTR) process is changing. In future all digital checks must be carried out through a registered Digital Verification Service Provider (DVSP).  Checks carried out by non-registered providers will no longer offer statutory defence against civil penalties.  IDVT is a government-approved process using biometrics, passport chip data and police database […]
articles.ai_summary:
- Effective today, all Right To Rent checks in the UK must be conducted through a registered Digital Verification Service Provider (DVSP) to ensure compliance and legal protection.  
- Non-registered checks will result in the loss of statutory defense against civil penalties, emphasizing the importance of using the government-approved IDVT process that incorporates biometrics and secure ID verification.
